Wardell Stephen Curry II (born March 14, 1988) is an American professional basketball player for the Golden State Warriors of the National Basketball Association (NBA).[1]

He is widely regarded as the greatest shooter in NBA history.

Early life

Curry was born in Akron, Ohio,[2] while his father Dell Curry was playing for the Cleveland Cavaliers.

Professional career

Golden State Warriors (2009–present)

2015–16 season: Unanimous MVP

Curry became the first unanimous MVP in league history.
